event_summary: A small blue round object enters from the left, moves rightward across a wooden tabletop, passes beyond the tabletop edge, and exits the right side of the view.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a static view of a light-brown wooden tabletop beside a gray wall and a pale translucent sheet on the right. For several moments no moving object is visible. A small blue round object then appears from the left on the tabletop, travels rightward across the wooden surface, reaches the area near the tabletop's right edge, becomes visible against the wall/sheet area to the right of the tabletop, continues rightward, and leaves the frame.

reasons: The wooden tabletop, wall, and translucent sheet are visible.
The small blue moving object is not yet visible in the first frame.
